name: Helga Nemeczyk
bio: Helga Cardoso Nemeczyk, also called Helga Nemetik, is a Brazilian actress and singer.
place: Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

credits.title: God's Lawyer
credits.overview: Daniel is a newly graduated lawyer who faces family conflicts due to disagreements with his father's business dealings; his father is a federal congressman. Alongside a friend, the young man becomes involved in a case that dates back to past lives, discovering he is connected to a complex spiritual web.

credits.title: A Miss
credits.overview: A former beauty pageant winner dreams that her daughter will follow the family tradition and win a Miss contest. However, she has neither the aptitude nor the interest for it. On the other hand, her son seems to have more talent to claim the sash and crown.

credits.title: A Vilã das Nove
credits.overview: Recently divorced, Roberta is living her best life, until she discovers that someone has turned her biggest secret into the plot of a soap opera — where she is the villain.

credits.title: Christmas Full of Grace
credits.overview: After discovering a betrayal, Carlinhos takes a fun stranger to accompany him on Christmas. But Graça proves to be a madwoman capable of bringing the traditional family home down.

credits.title: Airplane Mode
credits.overview: When Ana, an influencer, crashes her car while talking on the phone, she's shipped to her grumpy grandfather's farm -- and forced into a digital detox.
